* Overview
This is a directory-level SUMMARY doc (an =OVERVIEW.org=), not a trackable
work item.  airctl's =DocumentScanner::is_overview_file= excludes it from
document scanning by file stem, so org-air must NOT render it as a doc row
and its =#+state: ready= must NOT inflate the v0.2 per-dir Ready count
(R20-5 fix guard — if exclusion regressed, a phantom Ready/#summary doc
would surface here).
